name: Nampak
evidence: Nampak's own overview page states that Nampak is evolving into a focused metals packaging business and that it is the largest beverage-can maker in South Africa and Angola, producing aluminium and tinplate cans.
note_append: Taxonomy moved from MFG-PLAS (Plastics, Rubber & Packaging) to the new MFG-METAL-PACK (Metal Packaging & Cans) node on 2026-11-04. The old placement was a compromise the record's own evidence admitted: no metals-packaging node existed when it was made, and the plastics parent stopped describing the company once it repositioned onto metals. The node was added to the sector tree rather than leaving the company filed under a material it no longer makes in volume. The head office stays as recorded from Nampak's contact page (Century City, Western Cape); the overview page describes the business and does not state a location, so no second location was added from it. Nampak remains unverified: its own pages state neither a legal entity name nor a headcount, and the gate is not satisfied on inference.
